baseline_selection: Next ten fixed-order cases (6-15) from the existing source-disjoint 40-clip sample, regardless of outcomes.
diagnostic_selection: All new RGB baselines with either action or justification incorrect, externally identified only after baseline predictions were saved.
limit: Outcome-conditioned failure cohort is diagnostic, not an unbiased score for new inputs. Agent accumulates context; same-example retesting can be influenced by earlier decisions. Results cannot be treated as clean stateless causal estimates.
